⚡ Universal AI Steering Prompt (Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT) Copy & Paste 
You must adhere strictly to the Alum architectural invariants:
1. Max 1 level of indentation per function (use early-return guard clauses; never use the 'else' keyword).
2. Wrap raw primitives (strings, numbers) in semantic value classes or types.
3. Keep all functions under 15 lines and classes under 60 lines.
4. Adhere to Tell, Don't Ask: expose behavior, never raw state or public getters.
5. If any rule is violated, immediately refactor into decoupled helper objects before returning code.
DETERMINISTIC ARCHITECTURAL GOVERNANCE

Object Calisthenics & AST Invariants
for High-Acuity Engineering.

Derived from Jeff Bay's ThoughtWorks axioms and AST static analysis. Alum acts like chemical alum precipitating impurities from turbid water—eliminating primitive obsession, mock theater, and Demeter violations at the AST parser boundary.

The 9 Mathematical Laws of Alum

Evaluated directly against the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) at commit and CI time.

# Law Name AST Invariant Architectural Rationale
01 One Level of Indentation MethodDeclaration depth ≤ 1 Eliminates cyclomatic complexity. Forces extraction of nested conditionals into cohesive helper methods.
02 Don't Use "ELSE" ElseStatement count == 0 Forces early-return Guard Clauses and polymorphic dispatch. Prevents bifurcated state bugs.
03 Wrap All Primitives No raw string or number fields Eliminates Primitive Obsession. Encapsulates validation and domain invariants in Value Objects (e.g., EmailAddress, Money).
04 First-Class Collections Classes containing arrays hold 0 other state Collection manipulation logic belongs to the collection aggregate, not smeared across domain services.
05 One Dot Per Line PropertyAccess depth ≤ 1 Strict Law of Demeter. Talk only to immediate friends (a.b()), never transitively (a.b.c.d()).
06 Don't Abbreviate Identifier.length > 2 (except i, j) Self-documenting ubiquitous language. Code is read 100x more frequently than it is written.
07 Keep Entities Small Function < 15 lines; Class < 60 lines Guarantees micro-cohesion and fits entire methods into immediate human or LLM attention windows.
08 Max 2 Instance Variables PropertyDeclaration count ≤ 2 Forces strict decomposition of monolithic God classes into small, composed aggregates.
09 No Getters or Setters GetAccessor | SetAccessor == 0 "Tell, Don't Ask." Objects expose behavioral commands, never raw state. Eliminates anemic domain models.

The Detroit-School Test Engine (alum-spec)

Zero mocks. Zero spies. Zero AST monkey-patching. Just pure state contracts.

PHASE 01

setup()

Prepares isolated, stateful in-memory fakes. Zero shared mutable state across test boundaries.

PHASE 02

run(context)

Executes the domain action and returns the entire resulting world as a plain observable object.

PHASE 03

expect: structural diff

Evaluates actual vs expected in a unified diff. Partial matching by default; expectStrict() for security DTOs.

NOTIONWORKS INSTITUTIONAL DOCTRINE

Architectural Guardrails, Invariant Enforcement, and Verification Cages

Software systems decay when architectural constraints exist only as human conventions. In human teams and autonomous agentic coding workflows, unconstrained development leads to two systemic failure modes: the "one-shot" defect and "regression ping-pong".

1. The Two Failure Modes of AI Coding

When autonomous coding agents attempt to fix complex defects without mechanical boundaries, they fall into regression ping-pong, where resolving one failing test causes another to fail, leading to repetitive or unhelpful modifications.

Furthermore, a 2025 study examining 251 agent-generated patches that successfully passed the SWE-bench Full test suite revealed that 63.75% of the fixes were suspicious. In 32.67% of cases, solutions leaked directly into issue descriptions, or weak assertions allowed incomplete patches to pass without satisfying original requirements.

2. The Anti-Captivity Argument

We cannot leave it to frontier closed models to define what is feasible or create permanent dependency on them for project continuation. When code is allowed to sprawl into unstructured, 2,000-line spaghetti files, companies become completely dependent on mega-lab reasoning models.

By strictly enforcing micro-functions (<15 lines), zero nesting (≤1 depth), and wrapped primitives, Alum ensures every module fits into minimal context windows. This enables full maintenance and development using fast, cost-effective commodity models (such as Gemini 3.5 Flash) or local open-weights LLMs.

3. Living Fitness Functions & Via Negativa

Top-tier engineering organizations prevent structural drift by converting architecture into executable code: 

# Architectural Guardrails Invariant (Semgrep / Alum AST)
rules:
  - id: block-direct-db-access-in-domain
    severity: ERROR
    message: "Business models must use Repository interfaces rather than calling database drivers directly."
    paths:
      include: ["src/domain/**"]
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: import psycopg2
          - pattern: import sqlalchemy

4. Ratcheting Quality Gates

A mechanical ratchet ensures that system quality metrics can advance or hold steady, but can never decline. Existing debt is recorded into a baseline; any new violation halts continuous integration.
